summary: Red Cat Holdings filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of up to $200M in common stock, with underwriter option for an additional $30M. The offering is at market price; last closing was $11.25. This is a routine capital raise through an underwritten follow-on, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or any other event-driven category. As a standard seasoned equity offering, it does not meet the criteria for special-situations classification.
